text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aww, dropped the catch again...
Whoops, it's almost time for training...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, like I care!
How could I go home without catching a single one?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...... Tsk. Come on,
I only skipped out just the once...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Here, take this... It's for you.
Not like it's an apology or anything, though!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I swallowed the urge to say, "If you can't bear the guilt, you shouldn't have skipped in the first place,"
and simply cautioned them to be more careful from now on.
